question: As of 11 August 2022, who is the Chairman of Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagdeep Dhankhar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajya Sabha**

 
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Indian Parliament and represents the states and union territories of India.
 
• The members of the Rajya Sabha are elected or nominated for a term of six years.
 
• The nominated members of the Rajya Sabha are usually experts in various fields and have the same powers and privileges as the elected members.
 
• The nomination of members to the Rajya Sabha is done to ensure that the house has a diverse representation of people from different backgrounds and fields.
 
• The President of India can nominate members to the Rajya Sabha under Article 80(1)(a) of the Constitution of India.
 
• The total strength of the Rajya Sabha is 245, out of which 233 are elected by the legislative assemblies of the states and union territories, and 12 are nominated by the President
 
• As of **11 August 2022,** the Chairman of Rajya Sabha is **Jagdeep Dhankhar** who is the current Governor of West Bengal.
 
• The Chairman of Rajya Sabha is the Vice President of India, who is currently** Venkaiah Naidu. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury:-**

 
 
• He​ is a Member of Parliament from West Bengal and the current Leader of the** Indian National Congress** in the Lok Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Narendra Modi:-**
 
 
• **​**He is the current **Prime Minister of India **and a Member of Parliament from Varanasi.
 
 
 
• **Amit Shah:-**
 
 
• He​ is a Member of Parliament from Gujarat and the **current Minister of Home Affairs** in the Union Cabinet.
